verdict.rationale: The only model-format evidence is that llamafile supports GGUF models (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Phi). Nothing in the pack mentions quantization at all, and none of the named formats (FP8, INT4, GPTQ, AWQ) appear. Quantization-format support is a fair question for a local LLM runtime, so the axis applies, and with no evidence the verdict is none rather than na.
